evidence: A settlement citing PF1 and PF2 can specify arbitration_first, AAA_commercial_arbitration, return_and_deletion_only, no employment restriction, no public filing, confidentiality, and a return_and_deletion commitment; a decision-maker missing those facts could instead choose a public court filing or broader injunction and fail the checks.
